Regression in statistical calculations caused #NAME? errors in Excel cells H46:L47, indicating invalid formula syntax or missing function definitions.
The run failed with a reward regression from 1.00 to 0.00. Specifically, test_derived_values_and_stats in /tests/test_outputs.py failed because cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected floating-point statistics. This error typically occurs when openpyxl or the spreadsheet engine cannot resolve a function name used in the cell formula. Avoid recent changes to the 'statistics' block formulas and re-validate the syntax for derived metrics.
